svg.text: the 149 trump5 nodes: A212's pad-0 verdict and A256's ray triage
tile = one node (13 gallery pages + 136 of A60's alive frontier). Solid = DEAD at s0 (pass 1). Grey stipple = ALIVE,
undecided -- never green. A thick border would mark class (b) (a contracted Trump image might fit): THERE ARE NONE.
Triage over the whole ray (scale and slot, every depth t in the pad's slab, boxes padded outward): class (a) 149, class (b) 0.
The five corner pins force g = id, and no image square lies in any node's H box -- A60/A83 discharged the Trump residue before A212 ran.
